I came to this clinic for a teeth cleaning.
The doctor was friendly, but the treatment felt rushed and the result was not satisfying. The cleaning itself took less than 15 minutes, and I left feeling that my teeth were not properly cleaned.

When I arrived, I was told the price would be 900 baht or more depending on the work. After the quick check-up, the doctor said it would cost 1,200 baht. In the end, she gave me a “discount” and charged me 1,080 baht, which still felt unreasonable given how little time was spent and the quality of the service.

What bothered me most was that when I expressed my concern about the rushed treatment and said I didn’t feel my mouth was clean enough, the doctor responded by saying, “How much would you pay for this in your country?”
This comment was unprofessional and dismissive.

Unfortunately, I won’t be returning to this clinic.
